result.topic_en: Euler reduces a Diophantine problem to making $\lambda(aa+bb)(2a-b)(3b-4a)$ a square, examines the special case $d=-a$, solves the condition $p=cc+dd$ in general with parameters $m,n,t,u$, and shows that the result agrees with the earlier solution, which is therefore more general than it first seemed.
result.transcription:
488 L. EULERI OPERA POSTHUMA. Analysis diophantea.
quae reducitur ad hanc formam $\frac{\lambda(aa+bb)}{(2a-b)(3b-4a)}=\square$, ita ut habeatur haec conditio
$\lambda(2a-b)(3b-4a)(aa+bb)=\square$.
Nota. Si N° III posuissemus $d=-a$, habuissemus $cc-bb+ac-ab=0$, quae per $c-b$ divisa praebet $c+b+a=0$, sive $c=-a-b$, unde porro fit
$p=(a+b)^2+aa=cc+dd,\quad q=-(3a+b)(a+b),\quad r=s=-(aa-ab-bb)$
$p+s=(2b+a)(b+a),\quad p-s=a(3a+b),\quad q+r=-a(4a+b),\quad q-r=-(2a+b)(2b+a)$
Unde quadratum esse debet haec forma
$\frac{\lambda(aa+bb)}{-(3a+b)(a+b)(2b+a)(b+a)a(3a+b)a(4a+3b)(2a+b)(2b+a)}$;
sicque quaestio reducitur ad hanc formam $-\lambda(aa+bb)(2a+b)(4a+3b)=\square$. Hic imprimis notatu dignum occurrit, quod per positionem tertiam, qua fecimus $p=cc+dd$, praeter expectationem, quatuor paria simplicium factorum ex calculo discesserunt.
Conditioni tertiae $p=cc+dd$ sequenti modo generaliter satisfieri potest: Quum sit
[-$cc+dd=aa-ac+bb-bd$, erit $cc+ac-aa=bb-bd-dd$, sive-]
$(2c+a)^2-5aa=(2b-d)^2-5dd$, sive $(2c+a)^2-(2b-d)^2=5(aa-dd)$ et
$(2c+a-2b+d)(2c+a+2b-d)=5(a+d)(a-d)=5mntu$;
unde colligitur $2c+a-2b+d=nu$, $2c+a+2b-d=5mt$ et $a+d=mu$ et $a-d=nt$. Ex his concluditur
$a=\frac{mu+nt}{2}$ et $d=\frac{mu-nt}{2}$;
inde vero $4c+2a=5mt+nu$ et $4b-2d=5mt-nu$, unde fit
$c=\frac{(5m-n)t+(n-m)u}{4}$ et $b=\frac{(5m-n)t-(n-m)u}{4}$.
Hinc $p=[5(5mm-2mn+nn)tt-2(5mm-2mn+nn)tu+(5mm-2mn+nn)uu]:16$
$q=[-5(5mm-2mn+nn)tt+6(5mm-2mn+nn)tu-(5mm-2mn+nn)uu]:16$
sive $p=\frac{5mm-2mn+nn}{16}(5tt-2tu+uu)$
$q=-\frac{(5mm-2mn+nn)}{16}(5tt-6tu+uu)=-\frac{(5mm-2mn+nn)}{16}(t-u)(5t-u)$
$r=s=\frac{5mm-2mn+nn}{16}(-5tt+uu)$.
Sit brevitatis gratia $\frac{(5mm-2mn+nn)}{16}=C$, ut sit
$p=C(5tt-2tu+uu),\quad q=-C(t-u)(5t-u),\quad r=s=C(-5tt+uu)$
eritque $p+s=-2Cu(t-u),\quad p-s=2Ct(5t-u)$
$q+r=-2Cu(3t-u),\quad q-r=2Ct(5t-3u)$
$aa+bb=C(5tt+2tu+uu)$;
quare formula quadratum reddenda est
$\frac{\lambda(5tt+2tu+uu)}{(t-u)(5t-u).-2u(t-u)2t(5t-u).-2u(3t-u)2t(5t-3u)}$,
quae reducitur ad hanc conditionem: $\lambda(5tt+2tu+uu)(3t-u)(5t-3u)=\square$. Statuatur $u=\nu-t$, fietque $\lambda(4tt+\nu\nu)(4t-\nu)(8t-3\nu)=\square$; seu posito $2t=w$ erit $\lambda(ww+\nu\nu)(2w-\nu)(4w-3\nu)=\square$; quo facto habebitur $p=ww+(w-\nu)^2$, $q=(w-\nu)(3w-\nu)$ et $r=s=\nu\nu-\nu w-ww$.
Quae solutio cum praecedente prorsus congruit, ex quo patet illam solutionem multo esse generaliorem, quam initio videbatur.
